Markets.title: Puravankara Q1 Results: Revenue surges 63% to Rs 877 crore; PAT at Rs 25 crore
Markets.summary: Puravankara reported a 63% year-on-year surge in total revenue to Rs 877 crore for the first quarter of FY27, alongside a 28% increase in pre-sales. During the quarter, the company rebounded to a positive profit after tax of Rs 25 crore and successfully delivered 745 homes.

Markets.title: Market opportunity for REITs and InvITs is set to increase 2-3x from the existing AUM by 2030: Report
Markets.summary: India's REITs and InvITs are projected to grow their assets under management by two to three times by 2030. This expansion will be driven by low market penetration across multiple infrastructure segments, according to an Ionic Wealth report.

Markets.title: India bonds sink on RBI's early close of FX swap facility
Markets.summary: Indian government bond yields rose on Monday after the central bank unexpectedly accelerated the deadline for its diaspora deposit swap program. This early termination disappointed investors who were concerned about the impacts on domestic liquidity and borrowing costs.

Markets.title: KEI Industries among 4 midcap stocks to hit 52-week highs & surge up to 15% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite the Sensex dropping 281 points, BSE Midcap stocks KEI Industries, LG Electronics India, Ajanta Pharma, and Ipca Laboratories reached new 52-week highs. Ajanta Pharma led these gains with a 98% monthly surge, while KEI Industries rose 20%.

Markets.title: 6 listed Indian REITs distribute Rs 3,136 crore to unitholders in Q1 FY27
Markets.summary: India's six listed REITs distributed Rs 3,136 crore to over 4.85 lakh unitholders during the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. This payout was driven by strong rental collections and stable cash flows, with their combined assets exceeding Rs 3.17 lakh crore.

Markets.title: RBI loan recovery rules 2027: What recovery agents can and cannot do
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's 2027 loan recovery rules establish strict boundaries for what recovery agents are legally permitted to do. Under these guidelines, agents are prohibited from using harassment, intimidation, or inappropriate contact methods while pursuing unpaid debts.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation cooled marginally to 9.78% in July as moderation in fuel and power prices offset rising costs in primary articles and manufactured products. Specifically, fuel and power inflation slowed to 20.05% from 27.41% in June, while inflation for primary articles and manufactured goods increased.
